description: Read one email message completely after an email_search call. Returns headers, plain-text body, and attachments as cached local file copies you can read directly. Marks the message read unless mark_read is false.
name: email_read

body_chars.description: Body character cap. Default 20000, max 50000; re-read with a higher cap for the rest.

folder.description: Folder the UID belongs to (must match the email_search folder). Default INBOX.

mark_read.description: Flag the message read server-side. Default true.
